item.title: ASMR Affirmations for Self Worth & Confidence ♡ (Hair Play & Personal Attention)
item.description: Hi everyone! Tonight's ASMR video is all about self worth, confidence, and reminding you that you're enough exactly as you are. I'll be gently combing and clipping your hair out of your face while sharing positive affirmations and comforting words to help you relax and feel a little better about yourself. We all struggle and you are not alone. If you're having a hard day, struggling with confidence, or just need a little reassurance, I hope this video brings you some comfort and helps you unwind. You deserve to feel good about yourself. If you're watching, listening for background noise, or falling asleep, I hope this helps you unwind and relax. 🌸Business Email: emily.asmr.business@gmail.com
